high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying photographs about the Park Fire in California, United States. The headline reads: "Park Fire becomes California’s sixth-largest wildfire ever; 368,000 acres burnt in just five days." It is edited by Moohita Kaur Garg and was last updated on July 30, 2024, at 03:26 PM IST. The image includes two photographs: Left Photograph: This shows a nighttime scene of a forest fire. The trees are ablaze with bright orange flames, and smoke billows into the dark sky.
